cases.name: intra-line-ideographic-space
cases.shape: the stage's replacement over the formatter's own U+3000
cases.note: The frozen regex is a Java pattern, and Java's `\s` is ASCII-only: `\s+` cannot match the ideographic space the formatter writes inside a line.

cases.name: replacement-dollar-group-cannot-fire
cases.note: After the trim no line starts with whitespace, so `\n\s{2}` cannot match: the `$1` form of the used sources is inert in this stage.

cases.name: replacement-dollar-without-a-group
cases.note: A replacement that names a group the pattern does not have throws inside the Kotlin `Regex.replace`, and the frozen falls back to `String.replace` — the literal text is substituted.

cases.name: entity-after-the-replacement

cases.name: template-chapter-title-try
cases.note: The statement-shaped template the used sources carry: a `try` as the whole program answers its completion value. The pattern's second alternative `\(第\d+.+页\)` needs a character between the numeral and 页, so on this page text only the template branch fires.

cases.note: A name the frozen binds nowhere throws a ReferenceError, which the source's own `try`/`catch` turns into the fallback text; the fallback is the marker this page carries, so the branch is visible in the answer.
